items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: So I joined Celestad's band, Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: That was Celestad. Celestad and Pierron and they were big society bands, you see. And they'd make more money. So I joined Celestad's band, Tuxedo band. They'd heard Rene very much because he liked it so much. He hated it. But there was nothing you could do but I was making more money and everything else. So I worked with the Tuxedo band. And the Tuxedo band, that's what, that's called an original Tuxedo band. And that was long before my time, payback time, and Johnny Sincere, Kirok, we went out with nothing but a…
Oh I see, they had fallen out. I want to ask you, Paul, why did Ridgely and Celestad fall out? They just didn't agree about running the band?

items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: So I was young, I followed them, and so that was the beginning of the original, Salastair's original Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: Black Rag and so forth. But there was a confusion came up between Ridgely and Salastair concerning some of the money. The band broke, broke up. Salastair quit the band. In fact, the band actually didn't break, but Salastair quit the band. But John Marrera and Simon Marrera came to me and said that they wanted to get Salastair and make another band, Tuxedo band. So I was young, I followed them, and so that was the beginning of the original, Salastair's original Tuxedo band. That was in 1924. Now that made, they…

The most popular number I think that he ever made. Well I was going to ask, we talked to Ridgely for about an hour or so one day, and he told us some of that story about how they split up too. And how they first started by wearing tuxedos even on the brass band they had on the street. I hadn't known that.

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: In fact, I used to direct the whole band. Different things we would play mostly my ideas. I was a very important man to Father Celestan.

ctx.x: Did Celestan direct the saxophone section or would he let you work out?
No, I had all that to do. In fact, I used to direct the whole band. Different things we would play mostly my ideas. I was a very important man to Father Celestan.
Would they, if you were playing a dance, would they like to play requests? Did they play requests? Yeah, we played requests.
